response.overview: The Lady of the Sand is presenting her second sand film devoted to help a Russian child suffering with cancer. A month earlier Kseniya has created a sand film for another Russian child Vladik Demchenko. Before that Kseniya was devoted her stories only to little Ukrainians. This film is devoted to a 5-year old girl Veronika Polyakova from Russian city Penza.
response.title: To Return Her Childhood
